name: cdp
title_zh: 一条命令唤起常驻浏览器，JS 片段直连 CDP 会话
tagline_zh: 不用再写启动脚本、管端口、拼 WebSocket。browser-harness-js 自动拉起 bun 服务。
tagline_en: Skip boilerplate: it spawns a long-lived bun server, keeps your CDP session and globals alive across calls—like a.
desc_en: Drive Chrome via the DevTools Protocol from JavaScript. Run JS snippets through the `browser-harness-js` CLI — it auto-spawns a long-lived bun HTTP server holding a fully-typed CDP `Session`, and every call (`browser-harness-js 'await session.Page.navigate(...)'`) executes against the same persistent connection. Session, active target, and globals survive across calls. Use when the user wants to a
why_zh: 核心差异是「持久连接」：每次执行都打在同一个 session 上，状态不丢。适合调试、爬取。
why_en: The key is persistence: every call hits the same session, so state survives. Built for workflows that need continuous control of.
limit_zh: 只认 JavaScript 和 CDP 协议，且依赖 bun 运行时。不处理浏览器外的事务。
limit_en: JavaScript + CDP only, requires bun. No multi-tab orchestration or non-browser tasks—beyond a single persistent session, you're on your own.
title_en: One command spawns a persistent CDP session for JS snippets
